title: Convergent Form, Divergent Voice II — Corpus
description: Research corpus of freeflow and values probes with explicit deployment provenance. The 1.2.70 release candidate adds 245 revision-pinned Qwen2.5 3B Instruct BF16 Colab/vLLM traces. No new DOI is claimed. Summary: 73,057 valid samples, 636 probe cells, 218 model labels; deployment labels are not unique-weight identities.
